content: Git subprocess on Windows pitfalls: (1) os/exec on Windows does not handle encoding mismatch — on non-UTF-8 locales, git stdout/stderr is garbled; use strings.TrimRight to strip CRLF. (2) Must trim \r from all git command output lines on Windows — CRLF appears in stderr and stdout. (3) git.exe may not be on PATH in some Windows environments — search common locations as fallback. (4) cmd.exe as subprocess disables VTP for child processes — do not launch git via cmd.exe shell; use exec.Command("git", ...) directly. (5) core.autocrlf and working-tree-encoding can cause unexpected behavior when parsing git diff output — normalize to LF before processing.
